sources.title: Switching mobile phone provider
facts: The guide explains Text to Switch
Customers can initiate switching using a free text process
limitations: Switching guidance does not establish coverage quality
Device and contract conditions remain provider-specific

sources.title: Telecoms price rises – what are your rights?
facts: New contracts cannot use inflation-linked or percentage price rises from January 2025
Specified rises must be shown clearly in pounds and pence before sign-up
limitations: Rights depend on contract date and terms
Pricing rules do not establish broadband availability

sources.title: Social tariffs: Cheaper broadband and phone packages
facts: Social tariffs target households receiving specified benefits
The page lists current prices ranging from £10 to £24
limitations: Eligibility and provider coverage must be checked
A listed tariff is not proof of address-level availability

sources.title: Your right to request a decent broadband service: What you need to know
facts: The page explains the right to request a decent broadband service
Eligibility includes technical and affordability conditions
limitations: A right to request does not prove immediate installation

sources.title: Mobile phone service faults and problems
facts: The guide helps identify possible causes of mobile faults
It explains when to report problems to the provider
limitations: Troubleshooting does not verify network-root cause
A reported fault is not general coverage evidence
